findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `list2cmdline` quotes for Windows process arguments, but leaves a path such as `C:\R&D\shop` unquoted. The printed `git -C` and `git worktree remove` commands then treat `&` as a command separator in `cmd.exe` and fail when followed. The changed board-count test computes its expected text with the same formatter, so it cannot catch this case. [Microsoft documents `&` as a special `cmd.exe` character](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/cmd).
